description:
Refactor the 'checkStock' method in 'InventoryService' class. Use IntelliJ's Change Signature refactoring tool (Ctrl+F6) to:

1. Rename the method to 'verifyAndReserve'
2. Add a new 1st parameter: type 'String', name 'locationId', default value '"MAIN"'
3. Add a new last parameter: type 'boolean', name 'strictMode', default value 'true'
4. Reorder parameters to match: (String locationId, String sku, int quantity, boolean strictMode)

The project MUST compile successfully after the refactoring. Do not manually edit call sites; let the refactoring tool update them.
